Criterion Domain

  • CURIE: gmeow:CriterionDomain
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CriterionDomain
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/norms

The subject domain of a criterion — an OPEN value vocabulary (relational, factual, aesthetic, safety, stylistic, …). Open: evaluation traditions disagree about the domain inventory itself (Principle 9).

Structure

Subclass of: gufo:QualityValue

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:CriterionDomain as a specialized kind of gufo:QualityValue. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
